title: The Great Desert Circular Rally
statement:
There are N gas stations along a circular route. Station i provides Gas[i] fuel and costs Cost[i] fuel to travel to station (i + 1). You begin with an empty tank.

Find the starting gas station index (0-based) from which you can travel around the complete circuit once in a clockwise direction. If no such station exists, print -1.
inputFormat:
First line: Integer N.
Second line: N space-separated Gas[i] values.
Third line: N space-separated Cost[i] values.
outputFormat: Print the starting station index, or -1.

sampleCases.explanation: Start at index 3 (Gas=4, Cost=1). Tank remains >= 0 throughout the cycle.
